namespace = ckcraft

ckcraft.1000 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes
    trigger = { is_ai = no has_character_flag = ckcraft_enabled NOT = { has_character_flag = ckcraft_pending } }
    immediate = {
        random_courtier_or_guest = { limit = { is_alive = yes is_adult = yes NOT = { this = root } } save_scope_as = ckcraft_opponent }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:ckcraft_opponent }
            set_variable = { name = ckcraft_opponent value = scope:ckcraft_opponent }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ckcraft_sequence } } set_variable = { name = ckcraft_sequence value = 0 } }
        change_variable = { name = ckcraft_sequence add = 1 }
        add_character_flag = ckcraft_pending
            if = { limit = { exists = current_travel_plan } current_travel_plan = { pause_travel_plan = yes } }
            debug_log = ckcraft_request_travel_duel
        }
    }
}
